$comment: The agent-native protocol surface. Small, composable, discoverable — an agent bootstraps from engine.capabilities without a 5000-token manual. Every command self-describes (schema, examples, side_effects, capability). Capabilities are granted per agent-scoped context (see DESIGN.md §12). This file is the source for `engine.capabilities` and `schema.list`.

capabilities.read: Query world + read simulation results. No mutation.
capabilities.simulate: Run the deterministic runtime and read its output.
capabilities.commit: Commit a proven transaction into a new world revision.

engine.capabilities.returns: Server version, granted capabilities, command list.

schema.describe.returns: One component definition with units + semantics.

change.plan.returns: Derived operations + affected_tests + risks (from dependency metadata; no internal LLM).

component.patch.side_effects: adds a typed op to a transaction; validated against schema+units

entity.add.side_effects: adds an entity op to a transaction

behavior.patch.side_effects: adds an FSM/rule op to a transaction; graph-validated without executing code

simulation.run.side_effects: runs the deterministic runtime; retains snapshots+events

tx.note: run against a transaction's proposed world instead of committed main

simulation.events.returns: Events in a tick range, each with a causal_chain.

test.affected_by.returns: Tests whose outcome depends on the given targets/components.

test.assert.side_effects: runs a test's assertions against a run; records the verdict + evidence links

evidence.render.side_effects: renders buffers for ticks; writes EvidenceManifest(s)

transaction.commit.side_effects: merges a PROVEN transaction into a new world revision; rejects on field-level conflict

critical_demo_trace: world.query q='why do blind-side hits occur' → CombatSystem + Hitbox.facing_rule
simulation.events sim=sim_baseline ticks=[205,215] → damage_applied with causal_chain showing facing_ok mismatch
simulation.run scene=fight seed=88122 input_schedule=<replay> tx=tx_gameplay_51 → sim_fixed
test.assert test=facing_hitbox sim=sim_fixed → pass (blind-side collision gone)
evidence.render sim=sim_fixed ticks=[212] buffers=[beauty,collision] → before/after frames
transaction.commit tx=tx_gameplay_51 → revision 143, unrelated components untouched
